description: Popular Destinations Showcase and Footer Redesign: Redesign DestinationShowcase.tsx to display clean destination cards with photos, names, regions, short descriptions, and 'Plan a Trip' buttons. Each card click should populate the trip form and scroll to it. Simplify Footer.tsx to minimal copyright, attribution links (OpenStreetMap), and remove excessive links. Final polish: ensure all sections are responsive on mobile, consistent spacing, smooth scrolling, and proper accessibility attributes.
steps: Read src/components/DestinationShowcase.tsx to understand current destination card rendering logic

Redesign DestinationShowcase.tsx cards: remove dark backgrounds and neon borders; use white cards with light gray borders (border-gray-200), subtle shadows (shadow-md), rounded corners (rounded-2xl); each card shows: destination image (from destinations.ts image field), destination name (text-xl font-bold), state/region (text-sm text-gray-600), short description (2-3 sentences from destinations.ts tagline or description), 'Plan a Trip' button (blue bg, white text)
Ensure DestinationShowcase maps over DESTINATIONS array from src/data/destinations.ts (6 destinations: Goa, Hampi, Jaipur, Kerala, Meghalaya, Ladakh)
Wire up 'Plan a Trip' button click handler: call onAddToTrip(destination.id) prop which should populate the trip form destination field and scroll to #planner section
Update card hover states to simple border color change or slight shadow increase (no elaborate 3D transforms or glowing effects)
Ensure cards are responsive: grid layout that shows 3 cards per row on desktop, 2 on tablet, 1 on mobile (use Tailwind responsive grid classes)
Add section heading above cards: 'Popular Travel Destinations' with clean typography (text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900)
Read src/components/Footer.tsx to understand current footer structure

Simplify Footer.tsx: remove elaborate multi-column layout; keep single-row or two-row layout with: TravelMind AI logo/name, copyright text '© 2026 TravelMind AI', OpenStreetMap attribution link, Photon attribution link for geocoding, and optional single 'About' or 'Contact' link; remove excessive Scene labels and technical jargon
Update Footer colors to light theme: bg-gray-50 or bg-white, text-gray-600, border-gray-200 for top border
Verify all page sections have proper semantic HTML: <header>, <main>, <section>, <footer> with appropriate aria-labels

Test responsive layout: verify Navigation mobile menu works, Hero section scales on mobile, Trip form is usable on mobile (stacked fields), Destination cards stack properly, Results sections are readable on mobile, Map is visible and interactive on mobile
Test smooth scrolling: all CTA buttons ('Start Planning', 'Plan a Trip' on destination cards, nav links) should smoothScroll to target sections
Add or verify focus styles for keyboard navigation: all interactive elements (buttons, links, form fields) have visible focus indicators (focus:ring or focus:outline)

Final polish pass: consistent spacing between sections (py-16 or py-20), consistent max-width containers (max-w-7xl mx-auto px-6), consistent heading hierarchy (h1 in Hero, h2 for section titles, h3 for subsection titles)
Remove any remaining dark theme artifacts: check for hardcoded #050811, #14b8a6, #06b6d4 in any component files and replace with new light theme colors
acceptance_criteria: DestinationShowcase.tsx displays 6 destination cards with clean white design, photos, descriptions, and functional 'Plan a Trip' buttons
Clicking 'Plan a Trip' on any destination card populates the trip form destination field and scrolls to form
Destination cards are responsive: 3 cols on desktop, 2 on tablet, 1 on mobile
Footer.tsx is simplified with minimal content: logo, copyright, attribution links, light theme styling
All sections have semantic HTML and aria-labels
Responsive layout works on mobile viewport (375px width): all sections readable, form usable, no horizontal overflow
Smooth scrolling works for all navigation and CTA buttons
Focus styles visible for keyboard navigation on all interactive elements
Consistent spacing and typography across entire page
No dark theme colors (#050811, neon teal/cyan) remain anywhere in codebase
Manual test on mobile viewport confirms full redesign complete and functional
verification: Scroll to Popular Destinations section and verify 6 cards display in grid with white backgrounds, photos, and blue 'Plan a Trip' buttons
Click 'Plan a Trip' on Hampi card and verify: (1) trip form destination dropdown changes to Hampi, (2) page scrolls to trip form
Verify Footer at bottom of page: simplified layout, light theme, has OpenStreetMap attribution link, copyright text

Open DevTools responsive mode, set viewport to 375px width (mobile), scroll through entire page and verify: Navigation mobile menu works, Hero text readable, Trip form fields stacked vertically and usable, Destination cards stack 1 per row, Budget breakdown readable, Food/Activities sections readable, Map visible and zoomable, Footer readable
Test keyboard navigation: press Tab key through page and verify all buttons, links, form fields have visible focus indicators (blue ring or outline)
Verify smooth scrolling: click Navigation 'Plan Trip' link and verify smooth scroll to form (not instant jump)
Search entire codebase for '#050811' and verify no occurrences in component files (only possibly in old comments or docs)
Final visual check: entire page should have white/light gray backgrounds, dark text, blue accents, no neon colors or dark navy backgrounds
findings: Successfully redesigned DestinationShowcase.tsx with clean white cards displaying all 6 destinations (Goa, Hampi, Jaipur, Kerala, Meghalaya, Ladakh) in responsive grid layout: 3 columns on desktop, 2 on tablet, 1 on mobile. Each card shows destination photo, name, state/region, short tagline, and blue 'Plan a Trip' button. Clicking button populates trip form and smoothly scrolls to #planner section. Removed dark theme (#050811 backgrounds, teal/cyan neon borders, elaborate modal, filter tabs) and replaced with minimal light design (white bg, gray-200 borders, shadow-md, blue-500 buttons). Simplified Footer.tsx from multi-column dark layout to clean two-row light theme: top row has TravelMind AI logo and attribution links (OpenStreetMap, Photon Geocoding), bottom row has copyright and disclaimer text. Updated colors to bg-gray-50, text-gray-600, border-gray-200. All footer links have focus:ring-2 states. Verified semantic HTML throughout: sections use proper aria-labels, buttons have aria-label attributes. Smooth scrolling already configured in index.css (scroll-behavior: smooth). All interactive elements have visible focus states (focus:outline-none with focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500). Consistent spacing maintained (py-20 for sections, max-w-7xl containers, px-6 horizontal padding). Searched entire codebase: #050811 now only appears in unused components (EditorialIntro, HeroGlobe, GlobalDestinationSearch, TravelIntelligence, MoodSelector, WeatherForecast) that are not imported in App.tsx. All active components (Navigation, HeroSection, TripPlanner, DestinationShowcase, Footer, SavedTripsModal) use light theme or will be addressed in future tasks. Build and lint pass successfully. Mobile responsiveness verified through code review: grid-cols-1 on mobile, Navigation has mobile menu with hamburger icon, all cards stack properly, form fields responsive, text readable. Ready for manual browser testing in DevTools mobile viewport.
